reviews.positiveText: La ubicación es excelente: está muy bien conectado y se puede llegar fácilmente desde el aeropuerto en metro, prácticamente sales de la estación y estás ahí. Las habitaciones son cómodas para ser un hostel, con buen ambiente y huéspedes respetuosos. Tiene buen WiFi, cocina equipada para guardar comida, varias duchas y baños disponibles, y servicios como lavandería que hacen la estancia práctica. En general, ofrece una muy buena relación calidad-precio considerando lo céntrico que es.
reviews.negativeText: El acceso con equipaje puede ser incómodo, ya que hay escaleras y las habitaciones están en el segundo o tercer piso, y esto podría comunicarse mejor en el anuncio para que los huéspedes estén más preparados. Tampoco es muy práctico el servicio de storage gratuito que ofrecen: tuve que caminar hasta otra propiedad de la misma cadena, lo que implicó una subir la cuestas de Surry Hills y es una caminata de unos 30 minutos, pero es más rápido si se hace en Uber. El sistema de recepción es remoto (pantallas con atención desde fuera del país), lo que puede hacer el check-in más lento o confuso. Además, las puertas con código a veces fallan, lo cual puede ser incómodo. Finalmente, al estar en una zona con vida nocturna, puede haber algo de ruido los fines de semana, y la limpieza es correcta pero no impecable.

reviews.title: I went to the room and left
reviews.positiveText: I don't have any positive feedback. I found the info on the page confusing and the experience frustrating
reviews.negativeText: I turned up to the room and I thought I had booked a room with 2 bunk beds and a private bathroom. It said twin so I thought I had booked for the 2 people even though I was traveling on my own. I wanted to book the room for myself and was happy to pay for both. The price looked to be double the single person rate. But someone else, a stranger, was already sleeping in the bottom bunk when I arrived. I have back issues so the top bunk was not very easy for me and I had thought I would be able to use the bottom bunk when I made the booking. I recently did a similar thing at another place in Bondi. It was only 9pm and the other person already had their stuff literally all over the place, in the room, the kitchenette and the bathroom, and they were already asleep in the bottom bunk. They also had the aircon blaring on some hot setting so the room was like an oven. I tried to message the chat as there was no staff there that I could find and they took ages to reply. I asked if there was another room I could change to and they said no they were already booked. I asked for a locker I could use to put my personal things in with a lock. They finally replied and said there was a locker but you have to bring your own lock. Which I didn't have with me... and I did not see info about this on the pages or messages/emails. It was very heavy rain outside so I sat in the kitchen for a bit to try and figure out what to do.. I decided to book a room at another hotel near by which was expensive but I needed to be able to sleep for the next day of work and not have to sleep in some kind of sauna with a stranger and no security for my belongings. I don't usually leave negative reviews but I was really put out with this experience. They did try to apologise on the chat and offer me a different private room for another night with a small discount but I was only staying one night in Sydney for work. Much clearer info on the page would have helped.

reviews.title: Que sea barato no implica que su mantenimiento sea deficiente.
reviews.positiveText: Si estás valorando este hostel en tu estancia en Sydney posiblemente será por su ubicación y porque es de los que incluye desayuno y cena en el precio. Posiblemente ambos puntos son sus claras ventajas para decidirse frente a otros, aunque con matices. Respecto a la ubicación, personalmente creo que es su punto fuerte. Bien conectado a la estación central de tren, está en un punto que andando puedes llegar a Circular Quay en apenas 30-40 minutos andando a un ritmo normal. Estás en un punto que si te decides por ir a The Rocks, o a la zona de Chinatown, también está a menos de 30 minutos andando, por lo que estás prácticamente en el centro de todo. Si además planeas acercarte a Bondi Beach desde aquí, hay línea de autobús y en menos de 1h de trayecto estás allí con un solo transbordo. Otro de sus puntos positivos, en mi caso debo destacar las habitaciones. Literas rígidas y cómodas que no se mueven en absoluto (si has ido a otros hostel sabes de lo que hablo). Colchones decentes por el precio a pagar y habitación relativamente correcta en cuanto a espacio (al menos en las habitaciones de 6 personas). Por último, la parte del desayuno y cena que incluyen en el precio. Desde luego que es una ventaja frente a otras opciones de hostel que no incluyen nada. Desayuno básico que se sirve de 7:30am a 9am, incluye zumo, leche, té/café, cereales y pan de molde con diferentes mermeladas, mantequilla y crema de cacahuete. Eso es todo. Simple y básico. Y lo mismo ocurre en la cena. Horario de 18:30pm a 19:45pm, suelen ser platos básicos donde no podemos destacar que sean las mejores opciones nutritivamente hablando. Pasta algunos días, pollo con puré de patata otros, o arroz con carne picada. No esperes la mejor cena posible, de hecho da más sensación de comedor social que de hostel.
reviews.negativeText: Soy crítico porque en mis últimos 5 meses viajando he estado en muchos hostel y entiendo que si busco las opciones más económicas, renuncio a ciertas comodidades que otros más caros si me ofrecen (como más cantidad de baños, cocinas más grandes y más equipadas, zonas comunes de mejor calidad y más amplias, etc). Lo que no está bien es la falta de mantenimiento general del lugar. Es un hostel viejo si nos centramos en sus comodidades, y salvo las habitaciones que a mi parecer estaban en buen estado general, el resto fue bastante decepcionante. La mayoría de baños estaban viejos y no funcionaban como deberían. Ya sea un grifo roto, una ducha sin mucha presión de agua u otro con el suelo siempre con agua. Se notaba una falta de mantenimiento del lugar. Por no decir que en general estaban sucios. Paredes de las duchas por ejemplo que dudo se hayan limpiado en los últimos meses, papeleras llenas muchas ocasiones, y en definitiva, sensación de abandono. Por supuesto, entiendo que pagar un precio reducido por una noche en Sydney con desayuno y cena incluido, tienes que renunciar a cierto confort en tu estancia. Pero eso no implica llegar a un lugar con poco mantenimiento y con zonas sucias en general.

I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion. I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times. Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless. reviews.negativeText: Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations. There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion. Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided. On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag. There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates. Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning. There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

De sa att vi kunde byta till det rätta rummet dagen efter men INTE få återbetalt för natten i det hemska rummet vi hade. De sa även att det inte var återbetalningsbart trots att det inte appliceras i fall där kunden har blivit SCAMMAD. Till slut går det med på att återbetala om vi lämnar SAMMA KVÄLL, klockan var 20:00 och det var otroligt påfrestande. Vi fråga om det gick bra att byta till det rätta rummet morgonen efter då vi inte kunde hitta boende. ”Kundtjänst” sa då följande: Ni har fått rätt rum, alla de privata rummet ser ut så, bilderna på Booking är bara ”refrensbilder” - trots att de hade sagt att vi fick fel rum? Vi fick tag på Booking som hjälpte oss att få full återbetalning och vi lämnade samma kväll. Kort sagt, rummen ser inte ALLS ut som de gör på bilderna och jag avråder samtliga personer från att bo här.

We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken. - Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight. - The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make. - there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times. Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.positiveText: The people I met were lovely and was sad to end my stay early for that.
reviews.negativeText: Honestly, I never thought I'd write a bad review but I'm quite disappointed at this point. I was given a room in the basement which was fine but it was quite stuffy and it smelt very damp. They gave me a new room but I had to pay an upgrade. The new room was a bit better but still smelt. There wasn't any staff, just a virtual receptionist which is fine but makes it a little harder to speak to someone. Most people there seem to be inbetween jobs/working which is also fine but not the vibe I was looking for (everyone I met was lovely though). By this point I was tempted to leave. The last thing that made me leave was when I pulled the curtain in my bed to get out, it fell and hit my face. It hurt! I spoke to them over WhatsApp and they were very apologetic. However, no one got back to me about a resolution and to be honest I never expect a refund or anything but was quite fed up by this point and just disappointed no one got back to me even after reminding them. I hate writing bad reviews and understand hostels are hostels but I do expect the basics to be decent at least. I waited a while before writing this but I needed to be honest.

reviews.negativeText: Do not stay here if you can afford something else, it’s not worth it. Upon arriving there is no staff physically at the property which I found strange only someone on an iPad. The room smelt bad as something had spilt on the floor so I changed rooms, the next room had people who brought others in the room who weren’t staying there and spoke until gone 12am, not to mention his 5 mobile phones lying around… The bathrooms were always dirty and soaking wet as the shower was in the toilet. The door didn’t lock unless you pulled it and the front door was always wedged open so security was non existent and I didn’t feel safe staying there. If you were lucky to get a charging plug on top bunk, they were multiple extension leads together which looked very dangerous to me. The dinner was very bland and I didn’t bother after my chicken looked very grey. Overall I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone I know to stay and certainly wouldn’t return myself.
